linked_diagnostic.source_sha256_scope: Historical probe source snapshot before the unchanged Recompile_CACHE definition moved into DynarecOpcodes.cpp.
linked_diagnostic.report_scope: Fresh audit of the pinned historical linked image; metadata and report hashes bind these results. Absolute operand identities remain partly unresolved or inferred.

behavior_verification.scope: Reference-vs-ordinary-COFF execution with external calls captured. Native helper effects, emitted argument traces, branch selection, breakpoint records, cache clears and FPU labels compare. Not full linked program behavior or machine-code equality.
scenarios: 32 combinations per translation handler: register fields, signed immediates, TLB enable/mapped state, slow memory checks, recompiler mode, FPU format selection and delay slots
All eight byte alignments and three operand patterns for each native unaligned 64-bit helper
Page invalidation in three recompiler modes
Every selected-page membership pattern for breakpoint arrays of zero through four entries
behavior_verification.source_binding: This execution evidence is pinned to the historical ordinary-COFF object and checker, not asserted to be a compilation of the current regrouped translation units. The separate linked proof binds its own historical C++ source snapshot.

remaining_differences: All 31 historical function instruction bodies match after relocation normalization. This is not raw executable byte equality.
The fresh audit reports 2 unresolved and 473 unverified relocation identities; no independently known target mismatches.
Behavioral evidence covers 930 sampled cases with external callees captured, not execution of the complete linked application.
Original names, source boundaries and private data identities remain partly inferred. Scratch artifacts are outside git; their hashes identify the audited evidence.
source_organization: Most memory load/store translators and invalidation helpers reside in DynarecMemoryOps.cpp. Recompile_CACHE is grouped with system-instruction translators in DynarecOpcodes.cpp; names and unit boundaries remain inferred. Complete bodies are unchanged by this regrouping.

regrouping_audit.scope: Compared the pinned historical linked source snapshot to the current source hashes recorded above. This verifies source regrouping only; it is not a new executable match claim.

source_reference_scope: source_units and per-function source fields describe the current definitions. A top-level source is the primary unit. Recorded proof source paths and hashes continue to identify their historical compiler inputs; they are not reassigned by this source-organization update.
